question: What recitation and purifying substances are prescribed as part of the remedial procedure?
premises: Recitation is required as part of the remedy.
Ten thousand recitations or more are prescribed.
The five cow products and nectar and so on are to be used.
inference: After reciting ten thousand times or more, one should use the five cow products, nectar, and related substances.
uncertainties: The full ritual application of these substances is not detailed in this verse.
plain_english: Having recited ten thousand times or more, one should use the five cow products, nectar, and so on.
